answer: The harbor debit happens at intake, river totals the burned amount, and umber anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm as a result pays the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 13 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. That is 14 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
